businessStatus: Synthetic placeholder, not a client-approved invoice contract
classificationThresholdStatus: Provisional; evaluate on held-out data before accepting
requiredClassesExplanation: Documents must collectively support every required field; six classes in the demo are not an assumed client business requirement.
conflictPolicy: Normalize equivalent values; send substantively conflicting required values to ManualException. Source priority selects among consistent evidence and does not silently override a conflict.
llmConfidencePolicy: Do not use model self-reported confidence as calibrated probability
evidencePolicy: Validate document identifier, page bounds, and supporting text or approved deterministic transformation for every selected document value; manifest values must match whitelisted manifest fields

normalization.general: Trim and collapse whitespace, preserve originals
normalization.identifiers: Preserve leading zeros and punctuation; do not guess corrections
normalization.dates: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; ambiguous numeric dates require review
normalization.borrowers: Preserve all borrower names; no fuzzy merges
normalization.addresses: Whitespace normalization only initially; no geocoding or inferred components

submissionType.note: Whitelisted trigger metadata supplied by the staging manifest; not an LLM guess

completionRule: Only mark Returned after Cosmos read-back matches the submission/revision and an atomic local result write succeeds
replayRule: Same submission ID and same content is a replay; changed content under the same ID requires an explicit new revision, not automatic overwrite
piiLogPolicy: Logs contain IDs, stages, timing, model versions, errors and counters; field values and OCR text remain in restricted result/evidence storage
